name: davi-route
description: EXPERIMENTAL routing hooks for measuring a verifier inside Claude Code, plus davi-read. Turn features on and off with /davi-route:setup: subagent routing (tiers by default: rate the task's difficulty and send it to the cheap, mid or strong model; or post, pre, both) and a completion check at Stop. The settings dialog holds only the connection: the Davi server URL and keys. All off by default and fail-open. davi-read (skill): the passages of a web page or file that answer a question, verbatim, chosen by Davi. Install as davi-route@datumo, or load with --plugin-dir from an EVAL.Davi checkout.

davi_base_url.title: Davi server URL
davi_base_url.description: http://host:port of your Davi server, used by routing, the completion check and davi-read. Turn the features on with /davi-route:setup.

davi_api_key.title: Davi server key (optional)
davi_api_key.description: Only if your Davi server requires a bearer key. Used by the hooks; davi-read reads DAVI_API_KEY instead.
